splitters.label: Off
splitters.notes: Do not split saved episodes automatically.

raw_task.name: bottle_in_out_raw
raw_task.goal: Record one long continuous bottle in/out episode for automatic splitting.
raw_task.desc: Continuous raw recording for repeated bottle in/out motions. This raw episode is the source file and should be kept after successful auto-splitting.
raw_task.steps: Repeat: place the bottle into the paper box, then take the bottle out from the paper box. Keep recording continuously without stopping between cycles.

forward.name: place_bottle_in_paper_box
forward.description: Bottle starts near the initial region, then is placed into the paper box.

backward.name: take_bottle_out_of_paper_box
backward.description: Bottle starts inside the paper box, then is taken out and returned near the start region.
